Document creation fails with FileNotFoundError when loading default settings

#### Description

When creating a new document, the library fails to load the default settings template file, causing document creation to fail with a FileNotFoundError.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from docx import Document

# This should create a new document but fails
doc = Document()
```

The error occurs during the initialization process when the library tries to load the default settings XML template. The issue appears to be related to incorrect path construction for locating the template file.

#### Expected Behavior

Creating a new Document should work without errors and produce a valid document object.

#### Actual Behavior

Document creation fails with a FileNotFoundError when trying to read the default settings template.
